02ad392b-b200-58ce-a96d-f7cd57a5a252.question: What academic mathematics book does Lisbeth Salander carry around and memorize?
02ad392b-b200-58ce-a96d-f7cd57a5a252.answer: "Dimensions in Mathematics" by Dr. L. C. Parnault (Harvard University Press, 1999).

e23fcfc0-fc13-5abc-b7d3-9d91ae09cc49.question: What is the name of the secret rogue unit within Säpo responsible for protecting Zalachenko and persecuting Lisbeth?
e23fcfc0-fc13-5abc-b7d3-9d91ae09cc49.answer: The Section (Sektionen), also called the Section for Special Analysis. It is distinct from Edklinth's Constitutional Protection Unit, which investigates the conspiracy.

ad6aba37-9261-56da-bf3b-713f0cf07851.question: Who shoots and kills Alexander Zalachenko in Sahlgrenska Hospital?
ad6aba37-9261-56da-bf3b-713f0cf07851.answer: Evert Gullberg, the retired former head of the Section for Special Analysis, shoots and kills Zalachenko. Gullberg then shoots himself in an attempted suicide but initially survives. He dies three months later; the novel says cancer, rather than the bullet, finally determines his death.

8becb9a1-f9bc-5dae-8068-628617294f1e.question: Why did Amazon women allegedly cut off one of their breasts, and where did they live?
8becb9a1-f9bc-5dae-8068-628617294f1e.answer: The novel recounts a legend that Amazons removed the right breast to facilitate drawing a bow, but explicitly doubts that this was historically practised. Its geographic traditions include the Amazons of Libya (north Africa west of Egypt) and women warriors of Anatolia; it also recounts ancient Greek Amazon legends.
